The video ends with a high-angle shot of the woman yelling excitedly at the camera with a yellow radiating graphic background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, high-energy male voice speaking rapidly with a dramatic pitch contour. An upbeat, high-tempo pop drum beat starts immediately. (2) A softer, feminine voice interrupts with a playful tone. The music remains steady. A comedic 'pop' sound effect is heard during the transition. (3) Background chatter and the rustling of clothing are audible under the dialogue. The male voice continues with a high-arousal, comedic delivery. (4) A sudden shift in tone as the female voice becomes sharp and demanding. Dramatic fire-crackling and wind SFX are layered over the mix to simulate tension. (5) A triumphant orchestral sting and a loud, exaggerated laugh from the male speaker follow. The sound of a spray 'psst' is clearly heard twice. (6) Romantic, warm synthesizer melodies replace the tense music. The male voice adopts a more persuasive, narrative tone. (7) The video concludes with a loud, excited scream from the female speaker and a final percussive brand stinger jingle.
